refrigerants.fact: India (Kigali Amendment, Article 5 Group 2): HFC baseline = average production/consumption of CY2024-26 plus 65% of the HCFC baseline; freeze from 1-Jan-2028; cuts of 10% by 2032, 20% by 2037, 30% by 2042 and 85% by 2047. Quotas go to 2024-26 producers; calendar 2027 is effectively a 'free year'; a MoEFCC circular (Apr-2026) requires new capacity to be in place by 31-Dec-2027.
Navin's view: quota = 2024-26 average production plus 65% of R22 (HCFC) of 2009-10, so 'you must have a right to win'; Navin built capacity to use its full entitlement.

China: 2026 HFC production quota 797,800 t (Juhua 37.6%; top six ~90%); draft 2027 quota keeps the 2026 framework; R32 East-China price CNY62,700-65,500/t in Jun-2026 (a decade high, +19% to +77% YoY depending on the series); R22 ~CNY16,000/t (Dec-2025); China R32 exports Jan-Apr 2026 7,032 t (-50% YoY).
Navin CFO (29-Apr-2026): China R32 prices 'close to about $9' a kg and 'getting stronger'; the first Indian R32 capacity came in when prices were 'sub $2'.

Indian R32 capacity (PL, 25-May-2026): Navin ~9 ktpa (adding 15 kt), SRF ~25-30 ktpa, Gujarat Fluorochemicals ~10 ktpa, Stallion India ~4 ktpa newly commissioned; domestic R32 demand ~17-18 kt (SRF CMD, Jan-2026).

HSBC (17-Sep-2026): China cut R32 exports by ~17 kt in Jan-Jul 2026, helping Indian producers; risk of ~81 kt of new Indian R32 capacity into 2027. Sharekhan (17-Sep-2026): R32 prices to ease in CY2027 as new supply arrives.
Navin CFO (05-Aug-2026): over a decade R32 demand doubles while quota-driven supply halves; but 'India is going to be oversupplied for five years', so Indian producers must export.
US AIM Act: HFC allowances 60% of baseline 2024-28, 30% 2029-33, 15% from 2036. EU: HFC consumption phase-out by 2050.

cdmo.fact: Navin's European CDMO partner (Fermion, Orion's API unit) makes darolutamide (Bayer/Orion's Nubeqa, prostate cancer); Navin's CFO cites ~US$5 bn peak sales in 2028-29 as published by Orion and Bayer; Navin supplies a key intermediate and is moving to API-minus-1.
Indian CDMO peers trade at high multiples on 30-Sep-2026: Divi's Laboratories ~83x trailing earnings, Syngene ~50x (Screener).

agroSpecialty.fact: Agrochemical market 'going through a reset in a slow manner': volumes recovering, prices flat; LatAm 'already well supplied'. Navin's agro intermediates are export-driven and run as campaigns for innovators.

advancedMaterials.fact: Chemours' Opteon two-phase immersion cooling fluid for AI data centres; Navin is the only manufacturing site; Chemours booked ~US$1 mn of sales from it in its latest quarter (per an analyst on the Q1FY27 call); Navin says watch a ~15-month window for scale-up; significant revenue from a larger phase not expected before FY31-32 (Kotak, as reported).

moat: Integrated fluorine chain (fluorspar to AHF to R32/HFO/intermediates)
Advantage
Own AHF at Surat and Dahej (60,000 t); CFO claims 'lowest cost of manufacturing on 32'; but fluorspar is imported and China's quota holders set world prices.
Cost edge in refrigerants and fluorination, not a price-setter.
HFC quota entitlement from 2028
Advantage
Quotas go to 2024-26 producers; Navin ran plants full and is adding 15,000 t before the Dec-2027 deadline.
A regulatory moat from 2028, but capacity floods in during the 2027 free year.
Contracts with global innovators (Honeywell, Fermion/Bayer, Chemours, agro majors)
Advantage
Honeywell HFO to 2029 (+3-year option); Fermion MSA with dedicated cGMP4 block; Chemours' only plant; three customers = 38.5% of FY26 revenue.
Sticky, but concentrated: one lost contract hurts.
Fluorination know-how and handling HF safely
Advantage
Six decades of fluorine chemistry; 13 new specialty molecules in FY26; R&D ₹49 cr (1.5% of sales).
Hard to copy quickly; China has the same chemistry at larger scale.
CDMO track record
Parity
~50-55 molecules, half late-stage; one recent FDA read-out failed; revenue swung from -42% (FY24) to +59% (FY26).
Growing fast but lumpy; not yet a Divi's.
Pricing power in agro intermediates
Disadvantage
Management: pricing pressure continues, LatAm well supplied; 'not going back to 30% EBITDA' in spec chem.
Volume growth only; China sets prices.
Balance sheet
Advantage
Net-debt-free in Q1FY27 after the ₹750 cr QIP; ROE 20%.
Can fund ₹700-1,000 cr a year of capex internally.
